questions.subject: GERMAN
questions.learningObjective: Identify the German noun for monthly apartment rent
questions.stem: For item 0001, in an engineer's design brief, which German noun names the monthly rent paid for a rented apartment?

options.text: Die Miete is the regular monthly payment for a rented dwelling.
Die Hypothek is a loan secured against property rather than rent.
options.misconception: treats a mortgage as monthly rent

options.text: Die Kaution is a deposit held by the landlord, not the rent.
options.misconception: confuses a deposit with monthly rent

options.text: Die Nebenkosten are extra charges such as heating and water.
options.misconception: mixes ancillary costs with base rent

questions.explanation: Die Miete means the regular rent for a rented flat or house. The other choices name a mortgage, a deposit, or side costs rather than rent.
questions.hint: Think of the regular payment to the landlord.

questions.stem: For item 0002, in an engineer's design brief, explain how a traveler buys a one-way train ticket in German and names the fare class.
